examined_formations.title: INSTANT_RETAIL_STOCKOUT_AND_AFTERSALES_MICRO_ORCHESTRATOR
examined_formations.chinese_title: 即时零售缺货与售后微编排
examined_formations.attraction_summary: Stockouts, item adjustments, cancellation and refund states are frequent and machine-readable.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: JD and Douyin already expose store stock, stockout, order adjustment and aftersales/refund APIs. The transaction platform owns the customer order and the executable refund/adjustment action loop, leaving a third party mostly as merchant tooling rather than an unowned commercial control edge.

examined_formations.title: HOME_REPAIR_PRICE_AND_DIAGNOSIS_GUARD
examined_formations.chinese_title: 上门维修价格与诊断防坑助手
examined_formations.attraction_summary: Users pay for diagnosis and repeatedly fear opaque charges, while some platform prices are published.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: JD already provides paid on-site diagnosis, published category fee references, order/progress tracking and overcharge compensation. Unknown model/fault combinations still require engineer on-site diagnosis and negotiated repair/material pricing, so the residual high-value work is recurring human expert delivery.

examined_formations.title: PET_CLINIC_PRICE_AND_TRUST_MICRO_EDGE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 宠物医院价格与可信选择微边
examined_formations.attraction_summary: Pet owners actively seek lower-uncertainty hospital choice and treatment cost before visiting.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Ant Insurance already uses more than five million pet-insurance claims and 28 dimensions to dynamically evaluate hospitals and publish treatment-cost information. RuiPai and Tmall are also standardizing priced service booking. The most valuable decision edge is already occupied by a proprietary claims-data asset, while treatment itself remains professional human delivery.

examined_formations.title: COLLECTIBLES_PRESALE_AUTHENTICITY_AND_FULFILLMENT_GUARD
examined_formations.chinese_title: 潮玩谷子预售真伪与履约保障微边
examined_formations.attraction_summary: Non-delivery, authenticity, logistics and resale-price uncertainty create visible user pain in collectibles.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Xianyu Yuligou already combines official authentication, platform warehouse fulfillment, full-process video evidence, dynamic pricing and historical transaction data. A third-party layer lacks the physical custody and transaction rights that make the trust mechanism valuable.

examined_formations.title: SHARED_BIKE_OVERCHARGE_REFUND_EDGE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 共享单车异常收费退款微边
examined_formations.attraction_summary: August complaint data showed more than 7,000 shared-bike complaints and roughly three quarters involved overcharging.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: The leakage is frequent but small-value, and the bike platform controls geofence/billing records and refund action. Without platform cooperation, a third party can only help draft or organize a complaint, which is generic-agent substitutable.

examined_formations.title: GENERIC_ECOMMERCE_REFUND_AND_EVIDENCE_ASSISTANT
examined_formations.chinese_title: 通用电商退款证据助手
examined_formations.attraction_summary: Refund rejection and fake shipping remain high-volume complaints.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Major commerce platforms already expose structured refund/return workflows and APIs to merchants/ISVs. A consumer-side third party lacks adjudication/refund rights, and evidence summarization or complaint drafting is generic-agent substitutable.
